title: P39: franking credential domain check left to caller
description: protocol-06 §5.4.1.3 requires checking that the franking_agent credential names the hub's domain. mimi_mls::wire::Credential exposes only encoded bytes, and how a BasicCredential identity maps to a domain is unspecified (wg). Chosen: ReceivedFrank::verify does not check it; documented as the caller's (agent's) job, as in group_info.
